Technical data sheet - EF-210 epoxy floor coating
Part A: liquid epoxy resin, reactive diluent to reduce viscosity, quartz flour and
micro-silica fillers, silicone defoamer to release air during application.
Epoxy equivalent weight of Part A: 190-210 g/eq - controls the mixing ratio with Part B.
